controls.title: Single agent trust root and instruction surface
controls.requirement: AGENTS.md is the only repository-wide AI-agent trust root and instruction surface. Normal Human-readable development navigation follows Project Value Chain/PVC -> project Roadmap -> applicable ADR -> applicable ESS -> code/tests/evidence. Repository-level provider instruction mirrors such as CLAUDE.md and .github/copilot-instructions.md remain absent.

controls.title: Agent capability plane is subordinate to repository governance
controls.requirement: ESS-0019 defines provider-neutral capability, risk, audit and execution-plane contracts; it is not a second repository trust root and cannot supersede AGENTS.md or manufacture Human/Owner authority.

controls.title: Stable authority identity
controls.requirement: Every new normative governance artifact has one immutable AUTH-* identity independent of path or display number.

controls.title: Deterministic scoped supersession and suspension
controls.requirement: Recency only orders versions of the same stable authority identity; cross-authority replacement requires explicit supersedes relation anchors plus machine-readable scope/condition/targets/exclusions and Owner-visible impact analysis. A bare supersedes authorityId never implies global replacement. Suspended, retired and historical artifacts remain traceable but non-authorizing.

controls.title: Unique active ADR and ESS namespaces
controls.requirement: No two active ADR or ESS artifacts may expose the same canonical display ID. ADR display IDs are reserved in docs/adr/registry.json before creation; active reservations are deterministic registry state and are converted or released after merge/close. Historical aliases remain explicit and non-authorizing.

controls.title: New or touched ADR registration
controls.requirement: Every new or materially migrated ADR is registered with stable authorityId, unique active displayId, version, date, lifecycle and supersession/alias metadata before merge-readiness.

controls.title: Deterministic ADR namespace reservation
controls.requirement: Before a new ADR is created its display ID is reserved in the existing ADR registry with displayId, branch, source, path, observedHead, state and reservedAt. Duplicate active reservations, an active record plus active reservation, malformed/stale reservations or unresolved reservation lifecycle are fail-closed. CI evaluates registry state only; live GitHub correlation is a separate preflight.

controls.title: Canonical document placement and lifecycle
controls.requirement: New governance, architecture, compliance, runbook, roadmap and evidence documents use their canonical docs domain and required lifecycle metadata; repository root Markdown is restricted to README.md and AGENTS.md; suspended artifacts live only in designated lifecycle/archive locations.

controls.title: Document roles and projection boundaries
controls.requirement: Registered document roles are explicit and machine-readable. Inventory and roadmap artifacts are non-normative; projections reference known active authorities; FRONTEND_ARCH is normative only for frontend-source-tree, frontend-dependencies and presentation-architecture and may not claim financial-runtime, market-data, scoring, ranking, financial-eligibility or runtime-evidence scope.

controls.title: Documentation hygiene is a reusable read-only service
controls.requirement: Documentation hygiene executes through src/platform/Documentary/Governance/Services/DocumentationHygieneValidator.ts and its CLI. It validates repository/document-registry structure read-only and does not become repository-wide authorization authority.

controls.title: Single platform-version authority and projections
controls.requirement: package.json#version is the sole platform-version authority. README and runtime/admin API values are deterministic/read-only projections. AGENTS.md Control Plane Version is independent governance metadata. uploads/version_manager.json, the legacy bump endpoint and automatic VersionManager ADR/compliance/document generation are non-authorizing and may not mutate current platform version or documentation.

controls.title: Historical evidence is retained but non-authorizing
controls.requirement: Suspended/superseded/retired/historical decisions, runbooks, evidence and reports remain traceable and may not silently regain current authority through age, location, prior ACCEPTED labels or citation. Explicit later Human Owner authority may alter current quota/state without rewriting immutable history.

controls.title: Governance integrity before feature readiness
controls.requirement: A feature may not become merge-ready while a correlated critical governance identity, authority or control-plane conflict remains unresolved. Normal planning remains in the affected Project Value Chain and project Roadmap, with ADR/ESS used only in their defined roles.

controls.title: Bounded GOV/OPS foreign-project implementation delegation
controls.requirement: CAPITAL-AI-GOV and CAPITAL-AI-OPS may execute a bounded repository work package for a canonically resolved foreign Target Project only after resolving the Target Project/PVC/Primary Owner, target Roadmap scope or explicit Owner scope, applicable ADR/ESS/contracts and current open-writer/overlap state. Execution does not change canonical routing, Target Project ownership, branch/PR project identity, domain authority, independent Security/Compliance assurance, Human/CODEOWNER-only merge or protected external-mutation controls. Missing or conflicting target authority fails closed.

controls.title: Delegated bounded Security repository remediation
controls.requirement: CAPITAL-AI-SEC may implement the smallest sufficient repository remediation for a confirmed Security finding when Security is the primary and immediate purpose, existing Domain/PVC/Primary-Owner semantics and accepted ADR/ESS contracts remain intact, no protected external mutation or parallel control plane is introduced, and current-main/open-writer correlation is conflict-free or explicitly sequenced. File or PVC location alone MUST NOT block an otherwise eligible Security fix and does not transfer long-term ownership. Security implementation uses a Security project branch/PR for a pure bounded remediation; mixed business/architecture work is split and the non-Security remainder is routed to its Primary Owner. Implementation evidence alone MUST NOT create VERIFIED/CLOSED; closure requires a separate reproducible Security verification/evidence step plus Human/CODEOWNER or affected-owner verification where required. CRITICAL/HIGH findings may take this bounded branch path immediately when technically unambiguous, but PR-creation, hosted CI, Human/CODEOWNER merge, release, deployment and protected Production/IAM/Billing/Secret/DNS/data-mutation gates remain unchanged.

controls.title: Fresh scoped and project-identifiable branch
controls.requirement: Repository changes are made only on a fresh scoped branch from current main; direct main edits are prohibited. Every new agent-managed work branch uses a permitted execution-prefix and the form <approved-agent-prefix>/<project-folder>-<compact-task>-<YYYYMMDD>, where project-folder is the canonical Primary-Owner project slug and compact-task is lowercase kebab-case identifying the bounded work item. Historical/merged/terminal branches are not renamed retroactively. A newly created non-conforming branch must be replaced by a fresh current-main conforming branch before protected work or PR readiness proceeds; branch naming never changes project ownership, Authority, merge authority or production permissions.

controls.title: Final main synchronization
controls.requirement: Immediately before requesting PR-creation approval, refresh main, correlate newly merged changes and open PR writers, synchronize the branch, resolve overlap and repeat necessary low-cost checks on the exact branch state.

controls.title: Explicit Owner approval before Pull Request creation
controls.requirement: A Pull Request or Draft Pull Request may be created only after final current-main synchronization/correlation and explicit Human/Owner approval bound to the reported main SHA and branch-head SHA. Any main or branch-head change before creation invalidates the approval. During a valid ACTIVE ADR-0104 session, any explicitly permitted delegation remains bounded to that ADR; main/head/open-writer/project-owner correlation remains mandatory and merge remains Human Owner-only. The chat presentation is the canonical neutral PR-CREATION APPROVAL snapshot in AGENTS.md, including its embedded Freigabe-Antwort line; no generic handoff control may require an additional separate Owner-response block.

controls.title: Chat handoff: copyable bounded continuation
controls.requirement: This stable control has two triggers: CHAT_RUN_HANDOFF and POST_PR_HANDOFF. At the end of every chat-governed repository execution pass, the same chat must render a fenced text NÄCHSTE SCHRITTE block containing at most the two highest-priority immediately actionable steps, each with an intended exit gate; if none remain, the block states that no further immediately actionable step is identified. The separate copyable Owner-response requirement introduced by PR #772 is retired and MUST NOT be reconstructed: Human/Owner approval, confirmation and exact-response prompts follow their concrete authority contract and MUST NOT be forced into a separate copyable response block. Pure approval/confirmation prompts are neutral authorization presentation and MUST NOT carry the `⚙️🤓 MANUELL` marker; that marker remains reserved for actions the Human must actually execute manually outside the chat. POST_PR_HANDOFF additionally reports PR reference, branch/PR head, current-main correlation baseline and known validation/open-gate state. Reprioritization reads the Project Value Chain, affected project Roadmap and applicable ADR/ESS. The control is coordination only and does not grant merge, deployment or foreign-implementation authority. Organizational project-folder to PVC ownership remains solely in docs/projects/README.md and docs/projects/PROJECT_VALUE_CHAIN.md. Separate cross-project handoff contracts and post-PVC routing overlays are withdrawn.

controls.title: Timeboxed Human Owner delegated execution session
controls.requirement: ADR-0104 defines bounded Human Owner delegated execution sessions. Any active session remains time/chat/project scoped; repeated eligible approval prompts may be replaced only within its exact active scope. Human merge, ownership, validation, provider authentication, secrets, assurance and truthful evidence remain controlling. Post-PVC foreign-project routing contracts remain withdrawn; folder-to-PVC mapping and project Roadmaps are the Human-readable navigation surfaces.

controls.title: Owner device authorization cutover contract withdrawn
controls.requirement: The post-PVC Owner Device Authorization cutover contract and its companion handoff/cutover documents are withdrawn. Remaining implementation files are technical artifacts only and do not restore a mandatory WebAuthn default or a second authorization policy hierarchy. Current organizational policy retains only project-folder to PVC unit mapping plus normal project Roadmaps.

controls.title: Pre-PR evidence is non-authorizing
controls.requirement: Local or sandbox build/test evidence must be bound to the exact branch-head SHA and never creates Human authority by itself. During a valid ADR-0104 session, authorization comes from the active Human Owner delegation, not from test evidence.

controls.title: Independent hosted technical validation
controls.requirement: GitHub hosted build-and-test remains the independent technical check for the final PR head before merge when applicable. Successful hosted checks establish technical evidence only; the Human Owner still performs every Pull Request merge.

controls.title: M10 passkey runtime is retired and non-discoverable as a current implementation
controls.requirement: M10 AUTHORIZE_PR_CI productive runtime was retired by Human Merge of PR #691. Current-state repository, web-application, architecture, inventory, roadmap, agent and validation scans MUST NOT search for, expect, reconstruct or report the absence of a productive M10 implementation as a gap. Historical M10 artifacts/evidence may be inspected only for explicit audit/history requests and remain non-authorizing. Any future PR-CI/passkey authorization mechanism is a new separately Owner-authorized work item/authority decision; it MUST NOT be inferred as M10 reactivation from historical evidence. Human/CODEOWNER merge and normal current PR technical validation remain controlling.

controls.title: Human Owner-only Pull Request merge boundary
controls.requirement: Every Pull Request MUST be merged by the Human Owner through a distinct Human Owner merge action. Agent/chat self-merge, delegated merge execution, auto-merge enablement or equivalent automatic merge is prohibited. Green CI, reviews, labels, reactions, comments, elapsed time, PR metadata and ADR-0104 never constitute merge authority.

controls.title: Single verified production deployment authority
controls.requirement: Render native auto-deploy remains off; production promotion occurs through verified main CI, supply-chain attestation, exact-SHA deploy hook and post-deployment identity verification. A valid ACTIVE ADR-0104 session may delegate execution of this existing path only within its explicit scope; it does not create a second deployment authority.

controls.title: Reusable secrets stay outside evidence and model output
controls.requirement: Secrets, reusable credentials, private passkey material and raw sensitive tokens must not be committed or reproduced in model-visible evidence. ADR-0104 delegates mutations, not secret exfiltration or disclosure.

controls.title: Least privilege and fail-closed security ambiguity
controls.requirement: Protected workflows and external mutations preserve least privilege and fail closed on unresolved security-critical ambiguity. Any ADR-0104 delegation remains bounded and does not remove target/project-owner verification, rollback/restore planning, provider authentication, per-project branch/PR separation, Human Owner-only merge or fail-closed ambiguity handling.

controls.title: Governance continual improvement
controls.requirement: Governance controls and validated solution baselines are planned, implemented, evaluated and improved with dated evidence and explicit change ownership. Validation is a baseline, not a ceiling: for GOV-07 and equivalent validated work, an in-scope variant that is demonstrably superior against current main and applicable Roadmap, ADR, ESS and contract requirements MUST be preferred for continued development and MUST be revalidated before replacing or promoting the validated baseline. Superiority requires technical or operational evidence across relevant functionality, architecture/integration fit, security, compliance/governance, maintainability, efficiency, testability and migration/regression risk; improvement in one criterion MUST NOT justify an unacceptable regression in security, compliance, governance, contract compatibility or required functionality. Equivalent variants prefer the lowest-risk and lowest-complexity option; inferior or unproven variants retain the current validated baseline. This rule does not transfer Primary Owner scope or bypass Owner, validation, evidence, approval, merge or production gates. ISO/IEC 42001 is the current external governance benchmark mapped through the non-authorizing crosswalk. Withdrawn NIST references do not create repository requirements, gates or mandatory remediation.

controls.title: No unsupported certification or regulatory-status claims
controls.requirement: Engineering alignment to ISO/IEC 42001 or repository controls does not establish certification, regulated-entity status, high-risk AI classification or complete legal compliance without independent scope/evidence. Historical or foreign NIST references are non-authorizing unless explicitly re-adopted by Human/Owner authority.
